description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order to approve the acquisition of the immovable properties in Pothuwewa, Mahawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District for the constructions under Deduruoya Water Supply Project and in Gurunagar and Eachchamodai, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District for the constructions of Sewerage Pump Houses 10 and 04 under Jaffna- Killinochchi water Supply & Sanitation Project
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water treatment plant and sewerage pump house construction projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and claimants - all characteristic of land-related gazette notifications. While a minister is named (Rauff Hakeem), this is incidental to the land acquisition authority being exercised, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes described that would make it a government classification type.
